rootCauseAnalysis.summary: The payment service experienced issues due to an exhausted database connection pool, leading to connection timeouts and unavailability of database connections.
remediationSteps: Increase the maximum size of the database connection pool.
Optimize database queries to reduce connection time.
Implement connection pooling best practices to manage connections more effectively.
rootCauseAnalysis.probableRootCause: The database connection pool was fully utilized, reaching 100% utilization, which caused the connection pool to exhaust and resulted in connection acquisition timeouts.
